plan.line: a 1.3 inch 128x64 OLED display (I2C) that shows text and simple drawings in one color. At most 2.

code.pinLine:
OLED display {ref} on I2C{bus} (SDA {gpio}, SCL {scl}): "from machine import Pin, I2C" and "from sh1106 import SH1106_I2C", then i2c{n} = I2C({bus}, sda=Pin({g}), scl=Pin({sclG}), freq=400000) and oled{n} = SH1106_I2C(128, 64, i2c{n}). Draw with oled{n}.fill(0) (clear), oled{n}.text("Hi", x, y), oled{n}.rect/line/pixel, then call oled{n}.show() once after drawing. Not ssd1306: this display is SH1106.
  This screen: letters are 8x8 pixels, so 8 text rows at y = 0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 (the last row is y = 56) and at most 16 characters per row. The built-in font has only plain ASCII characters.
code.moduleRule: sh1106 when an OLED display is listed
